page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.2xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, supported by 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A key differentiator is its massive bundled local storage, consisting of 23,622 GB of HDD capacity.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.d1.2xlarge is tailored for high-capacity storage rather than raw compute speed. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, consistently fall into the bottom 25% tier. Memory read bandwidth is also weak, though large-block memory write bandwidth reaches average levels. Cryptographic and compression tasks, including single-threaded gzip and bzip3 operations, show poor to weak performance, reflecting the older generation of the underlying Intel Xeon processor.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers high storage density per resource unit, making it a viable option for workloads requiring massive local capacity without demanding high-performance compute or fast SSD I/O. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps. Given these characteristics, the ecs.d1.2xlarge is best suited for cold data storage, large-scale data archiving, log processing, and distributed file systems where storage volume is prioritized over processing throughput.
